why: second pass: two compound spell names, three names that collided with another spell's Persian, one description with numbers in the wrong order

descs.en: Reduces the Energy cost of your Expose Armor ability by 5, and refunds 1 Combo Point when cast with 5 Combo Points.
descs.fa: هزینهٔ انرژیِ توانایی [[expose armor]] تو را 5 واحد کم می~کند و 1 امتیاز ترکیبی را پس می~دهد، وقتی با 5 امتیاز ترکیبی اجرا شود.
